overview: The paper proposes EMPO2, a hybrid reinforcement learning framework for LLM agents that integrates self-generated memory (tips) to enhance exploration and utilizes a combination of on-policy and off-policy updates to internalize memory benefits into model parameters, achieving superior performance and adaptability in multi-step embodied environments.

modules.name: Multi-Step Environment Interface
modules.description: Abstracts and wraps interactive text-based environments (ScienceWorld, WebShop) to handle multi-step episode execution, action parsing, state observation retrieval, and environment termination signals.

modules.name: Self-Generated Memory Buffer
modules.description: Implements the external memory architecture to store, retrieve, and evict self-generated reflective tips based on state embedding cosine similarity and trajectory scores, enabling cross-episode knowledge retention.

modules.name: Dual-Mode Rollout Engine
modules.description: Executes policy rollouts with stochastic mode selection between 'Prompting Without Memory' and 'Memory-Augmented Prompting', collecting trajectories, rewards, and both conditioned and unconditioned log probabilities.

modules.name: Intrinsic Reward Calculator
modules.description: Computes novelty-based intrinsic rewards by tracking visited state embeddings, calculating cosine similarity against a state memory list, and assigning rewards for states exceeding a similarity threshold to encourage exploration.

modules.name: Group Relative Advantage Estimator
modules.description: Calculates the relative advantage for each action within a group of rollout trajectories for the same task by normalizing the sum of extrinsic and intrinsic rewards against the group mean and standard deviation.

modules.name: Importance Sampling Ratio Calculator
modules.description: Computes the probability ratio between the current and old policies, handling three distinct scenarios: regular on-policy, on-policy with tips, and off-policy (where old log probs include tips but new log probs exclude them).

modules.name: Stabilized Hybrid Policy Loss
modules.description: Constructs the EMPO2 clipped surrogate objective, integrating a low-probability token masking mechanism to stabilize off-policy training and applying KL divergence regularization towards a reference policy.

modules.name: Tip Generation and Reflection Module
modules.description: Prompts the current policy to generate concise, single-sentence reflective tips summarizing trajectory outcomes and discovered information at episode termination, subsequently storing them in the memory buffer.

modules.name: EMPO2 Training Loop Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the end-to-end training workflow, alternating between multi-step rollouts, tip generation/memory updates, and policy optimization with stochastic selection between on-policy and off-policy update modes.

modules.name: Out-of-Distribution Adaptation Evaluator
modules.description: Assesses the trained agent's adaptability to unseen tasks by evaluating performance over sequential trials using memory updates without any gradient-based parameter updates.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Framework
modules.description: Provides configuration scripts and execution logic for systematic ablation studies, including mode combination removal, memory rollout probability variation, off-policy probability variation, and intrinsic reward scaling.

modules.name: Experiment Tracking and Metric Computation
modules.description: Aggregates episode returns, calculates task-specific success rates and scores, logs training curves (entropy, returns, loss components), and generates LaTeX tables and performance plots for benchmark comparisons.
